# M2

> Every page of the M2 module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [M2 linking and sharing](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2): M2 base URLs and the operations grouped by use case.
- [Acknowledge a consent notification](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-consent-hip-on-notify): Also known as: Consent HIP On-Notify.
- [Generate Link Token](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-generate-link-token): Generates a short-lived link token for a specific patient identified by their ABHA number/address.
- [Notify the gateway that a data transfer finished](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-hip-data-flow-notify): Also known as: HIP Data Flow Notification.
- [Acknowledge a health information data request](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-hip-health-information-on-request): Also known as: HIP Health Information Response.
- [Link care contexts to an ABHA address](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-hip-link-care-context): Also known as: HIP Initiated Care Context Linking (Single or Multiple).
- [Link Care Context Notify](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-link-care-context-notify): Sends an explicit notification to the ABDM Gateway about a newly linked care context.
- [The outcome of a care context linking call you made](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-carecontext-result): Hosted by your bridge, not by ABDM. The gateway calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path above is relative to that URL. T
- [A consent notification to an HIU bridge](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-consent-notify-hiu): Inbound to the HIU bridge, at the bridge URL you registered.
- [The outcome of a care context notify call you made](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-context-notify-result): Hosted by your bridge, not by ABDM. The gateway calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path above is relative to that URL. T
- [The provider pushes encrypted health information to the URL named in the request.](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-data-notification): The provider pushes encrypted health information to the URL named in the request.
- [On Discovery, HIP responds with found care contexts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-discover-care-contexts): **Async Callback:** After receiving a discovery request at the HIP bridge URL
- [A discovery request for a patient you may hold records for](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-discovery-request): Inbound to every HIP. Answer with care context metadata only: a discovery response carries no clinical or sensitive data. A rejected answer is reported as ABDM-
- [The link token m2_generate_link_token generated, or why it failed](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-generate-token-result): Hosted by your bridge, not by ABDM. The gateway calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path above is relative to that URL.
- [A request for the records a consent covers](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-health-information-request): Inbound to the HIP, carrying the consent id, the date range, the data push URL and the encryption parameters. You have 20 minutes from this request to the data
- [Confirmation of a link, carrying the token the patient approved](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-link-confirm): Inbound to the HIP. A duplicate arrives as ABDM-1105, and a rejected answer as ABDM-1111.
- [A request to start linking a care context](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-link-init): Inbound to the HIP. A duplicate arrives as ABDM-1104, and a rejected answer as ABDM-1110.
- [The outcome of an SMS deep link notify call you made](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-on-sms-notify-result): Hosted by your bridge, not by ABDM. The gateway calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path above is relative to that URL. T
- [Link On-Confirm, HIP confirms linked care contexts](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-receive-link-confirm): **Async Callback:** After receiving a link confirm request at the HIP bridge URL
- [Link On-Init, HIP responds with OTP communication details](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-receive-link-init): **Async Callback:** After receiving a link init request at the HIP bridge URL
- [Send an SMS with a deep link to the ABHA App](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-sms-deep-link-notify): Also known as: SMS Deep Link Notify.
- [M2 Linking and sharing errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-9/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/errors): What M2 Linking and sharing returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
